title: Catalina Divers Supply & Snorkeling
specs: Catalina Divers Supply does not tolerate the use of drugs or alcohol before or during our trips.
Reminders: All participants must be at least 10 years old, able to swim and feel comfortable in the water.
You must know how to swim & be comfortable in deep water.
CDS does not tolerate the use of drugs or alcohol before or during our trips.
Minimum Age: 8 Participants must be able to swim and feel comfortable in deep water.
Anyone who arrives under the influence of drugs or alcohol will not be allowed to participate and there will be no refund.

Prerequisite: Open Water certification Two-day course Five dives Minimum Age: 15 | 12 for Junior Advanced Open Water Diver What to Bring: Beyond your own basic scuba equipment, you’ll need a compass and dive knife or dive tool.
Reminders: Minimum Age: 10 Prerequisites: PADI (Junior) Open Water Diver Complete E-Learning or Manual - 2 Dives You’ll want an underwater slate to record what you see and a fish identification card.

Prerequisite: Advance Certification Minimum Age: 15 20 Logged Dives Complete E-Learning or Manual - 3 Dives Equipment Needed: Deep Diver Manual, Scuba Gear, Dive Computer, Finger Reel, SMB, Underwater Slate.
Reminders: Minimum Age: 12 Prerequisites: PADI (Junior) Open Water Diver eLearning or Manual - 2 Dives In addition to basic scuba gear, bring a towel, dry clothes and a reusable water bottle.
